headline: Workers block Dhaka-Tangail highway in Gazipur unrest
summary: Garment workers have blocked the main highway in the Naujor area, causing widespread traffic jams as unrest continues in the industrial belt.
details: Garment workers have blocked the Dhaka-Tangail highway in the Naujor area of Gazipur, halting traffic and causing significant distress to passengers on Tuesday.
caption:
Traffic halted on the Dhaka-Tangail highway as garment workers block the road in Gazipur.

Garment workers have blocked the Dhaka-Tangail highway in the Naujor area of Gazipur, halting traffic and causing significant distress to passengers on Tuesday.

headline_marked: PM Tarique Rahman [[opens Bangladesh Solar Expo 2026]] in Dhaka
headline: PM Tarique Rahman opens Bangladesh Solar Expo 2026 in Dhaka
summary: The two-day event aims to encourage the use of solar energy on rooftops and unused land to increase national energy mix and income.
details: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman inaugurated the first-ever 'Bangladesh Solar Expo 2026' at the Bangladesh-China Friendship Conference Centre in Agargaon, Dhaka.
The exhibition, themed 'Use every inch of the roof, increase income from solar power', will run until November 4.
The event is jointly organized by the Power Division, the Ministry of Power, Energy and Mineral Resources, and the Infrastructure Development Company Limited (IDCOL).
The expo is open to visitors and includes four seminars focusing on the expansion of solar power nationwide and increasing its share in the national energy mix.
The Prime Minister visited various stalls during the opening ceremony to learn about the latest solar technologies and initiatives.
caption:
Can your roof earn you money? The first-ever Bangladesh Solar Expo 2026 is now open in Dhaka!

Prime Minister Tarique Rahman inaugurated the first-ever 'Bangladesh Solar Expo 2026' at the Bangladesh-China Friendship Conference Centre in Agargaon, Dhaka.

The exhibition, themed 'Use every inch of the roof, increase income from solar power', will run until November 4.

The event is jointly organized by the Power Division, the Ministry of Power, Energy and Mineral Resources, and the Infrastructure Development Company Limited (IDCOL).

The expo is open to visitors and includes four seminars focusing on the expansion of solar power nationwide and increasing its share in the national energy mix.

The Prime Minister visited various stalls during the opening ceremony to learn about the latest solar technologies and initiatives.

#Bangladesh #SolarEnergy #RenewableEnergy #Dhaka #GreenEnergy #SolarExpo2026

Source: Dhaka Tribune, Jamuna TV, The Daily Star
